Description:

Experienced Captain and Able Seafarer (AB) are sought for a Pollution Control Vessel operating in Germany. Previous tanker experience and valid Advanced Oil Tanker Certificates are essential. Location: Pacific
Description:

A Chief Officer position is available on a 55m private performance sailing yacht undertaking a world-cruising program, primarily based in the Pacific. The role requires a minimum OOW qualification, with Chief Mate advantageous, and essential strong sailing experience on yachts over 45m. Previous experience leading a deck team is important, as the position involves hands-on deck operations and supporting an active owner program. The successful candidate will oversee a Bosun and Deckhand.



Apply to this job

Location: Saudi Aramco
Description:

A Chief Officer with Master Unlimited II/2 or Chief Officer Unlimited II/2 CoC is required for an MPSV vessel. Minimum 24 months of experience as Chief Officer on MPSV, OSV, or AHTS class vessels is necessary. The rotation is 90 days on / 60 days off. Salary will be discussed during the interview. All certificates must be valid for a minimum of 12 months. Previous Saudi Aramco approval and relevant experience are advantageous.

item.description:
Location: Summer Isles, Scotland
Description:

A commercial Skipper is sought for a year-round role supporting a restoration and regeneration charity on Tanera Mòr, Scotland. Responsibilities include passenger transport, crew and cargo movements, logistics, and fuel transfers in exposed coastal waters. Essential qualifications include RYA Advanced Powerboat/OOW, Commercial Endorsement, ML5/ENG1, VHF/SRC, Sea Survival, First Aid, and Fire Fighting. Commutable to Badentarbat Bay is required; accommodation may be available. This is a Monday-Friday position within a working island community.



Apply to this job
